name: Kimi-Audio-7B-Instruct
notes: TWO-PART MODEL with the most unusual audio tokenization in this slice, and the only one that uses MiMo. (1) AUDIO (the compute-heavy part): use_whisper_feature true, so it consumes Whisper-style acoustic features, but the audio pathway is NOT a plain Whisper encoder bolted onto an LLM. The distinctive fields are the MiMo ones: kimia_mimo_layers 6, kimia_mimo_transformer_from_layer_index 21, kimia_mimo_audiodelaytokens 6, kimia_adaptor_input_dim 5120, num_audio_special_tokens 512, kimia_audio_output_vocab 16896, kimia_token_offset 152064, kimia_media_begin/end 151661/151663. Reading these together: audio is routed through a 6-layer MiMo audio model that is injected starting at LLM layer 21 (not at the input), and the model can emit its own 16,896-token AUDIO vocabulary in addition to the 152,064-token text vocabulary, living in a DISJOINT token space via kimia_token_offset 152064. That is why total vocab is 168,448 = 152,064 + 16,896 - 512. So unlike every other audio record here, Kimi-Audio is not a pure ASR model: it can reason over audio and generate audio tokens, i.e. a speech-in / speech-out model built on a text LLM. AUDIO POSITIONS are governed by num_audio_special_tokens 512 rather than a fixed 1,500-frame Whisper output, which is a much more compact audio representation than Whisper's. (2) LLM: dense decoder, 28 layers, hidden 3584, 28 heads / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, intermediate 18944, max_position 8192, rope_theta 1e6, rope_scaling null, tie_word_embeddings false, rms_norm_eps 1e-6. KV geometry independently confirmed from tensor shapes: model.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight is [512, 3584] = 4 KV heads x 128, matching the declared num_key_value_heads 4; q_proj is [3584,3584]. lm_head [168448,3584]. ARCHITECTURE = dense. KV CACHE: 28 * 4 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 57,344 B/token (56 KiB). The best KV-per-token of any audio-capable model in this slice -- 9.1x smaller than Qwen2-Audio's 512 KiB, for a larger model. Qwen2-Audio's MHA choice and Kimi-Audio's 7:1 GQA are the whole spread. flops_per_token_active = 2 * 9.766e9 = 1.95e10 is set here because this model decodes TEXT tokens through a normal autoregressive LLM, so the formula is meaningful; note it does NOT include the audio pathway, which is a separate precompute pass. STREAMING: audio enters as a fixed block of special tokens with no causal-chunked encoder declared, so treat as OFFLINE. params_b 9.766 = HF API safetensors total (9,766,336,640) -- the '7B' name counts the text backbone; the MiMo audio model plus the enlarged 168,448-token vocabulary account for the extra ~2.8B.
